costs.measurement_gap: Injected post-fit failure has no returned supervisor sample summary; worker high-water RSS and elapsed time are retained.
costs.scope: All 46 admitted attempts, including failure and recovery replay. Archive I/O, tests and offline report construction are outside run totals. Dense arithmetic excludes full SVD/backward FLOPs; elapsed time is not a controlled speed comparison.

decision.acquisition: Refit lr010 passes every one-step and mixed gate in all three seeds; joint has no common all-seed passing condition.
decision.development: All three refit seeds correctly predict 608 trajectories, all 1920 prefixes and 64 paired continuations, with own-state inference and sensitive input/state/action interventions.
decision.next: Separately register a representation-bridge experiment that retains acquired operations, controls mapping initialization and compares against task-specific retraining with full adaptation and inherited cost.
decision.scope: Three development seeds in one fixed fully observed nonlinear world. No foundation, novelty, language, new-world confirmation, practical speed advantage or continual adaptation claim.

lr003.scope: Descriptive comparison at the same rate and seeds, not significance or matched-total-compute proof.
